name: Effective Range
definition: The **effective range** $E(\mathcal{H})$ of a family $\mathcal{H}$ is the number of elements that can be distinguished by members of $\mathcal{H}$: $$ E(\mathcal{H}):= |\{x:x\in\mathcal{X\|,\, \exists h_1,h_2\in\mathcal{H},\, x\in h_1 \Delta h_2}} $$
graph_summary: The number of coordinates on which two concepts in the class disagree.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strict_c_monotonic.proof: By definition, strictly monotonic means doubly monotonic and strictly c-monotonic.

strictly_monotonic.proof: By definition, a doubly monotonic strictly c-monotonic parameter is strictly monotonic.

monotonic.proof: Adding concepts cannot make a previously varying coordinate constant.

p_monotonic.proof: Projection deletes coordinates and can only discard varying coordinates, never create one.
